saw_lines: Studio microphone buyers compare specs and reviews for weeks, then buy once and keep it for years.
So the sale is won or lost on proof. A new buyer needs a reason to trust the mic before paying.
Your 1 live ad carries no proof number, so add a review count or orders shipped to the creative and lead with it.
ads_1: Studio mic proof ads, with the Hear the Moment story as a second test
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram and YouTube
